description: "The Court of Chancery: A Satirical Poem" by Reginald James Blewitt is a satirical poem written in the early 19th century. The poem critiques the glacial pace and inherent corruption of the Court of Chancery, a legal institution in England known for its extensive delays and costly procedures.
